name: @c0dingbear/chromium-idb-reader
description: Pure-JS reader for Chromium IndexedDB LevelDB stores (the idb_cmp1 databases that level/leveldown can't open). Parses .log + .ldb SSTables, decompresses Snappy, and returns current (last-write-wins) records with their sequence numbers. Zero native dependencies.
author: c0dingbear
